name: magic-ai-assistant

scripts.build: node scripts/fix-wakeword.cjs && node scripts/fix-desktop-actions.cjs && node scripts/repair-desktop-actions.cjs && node scripts/fix-type-input.cjs && node scripts/fix-multi-action.cjs && node scripts/fix-focus-verification.cjs && node scripts/fix-vision-click-v2.cjs && node scripts/fix-site-search.cjs && node scripts/fix-site-search-runtime.cjs && node scripts/fix-contextual-site-search.cjs && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && npx electron-builder --win nsis portable
